title: His brothers Alec and Sidney
summary: Brother Alec is a drummer who can no longer hear; Bigard could not play with him; brother Sidney was shot in a fight over his wife.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: And you had what, one brother?
I have two brothers.
Two brothers. One was named A MUSICIAN.
One was Alec, Alexander, he was a drummer. He's still a drummer but he's in a bad way. He can't hear and so he can't work. [PAUSE]
We were talking about your brother Alec. Where does he live now?
He lives in New Orleans.
I see. Oh, yeah.
And he's old, you know. He's older than
I am, naturally.
How much older is he than you?
Oh, he's about in his eighties now. And he can't hear, because if he could hear, he could always play and make some money. So he's living off Social Security and food stamps and things like that.
Did you ever play together?
No.
No?
No, we could never play together.
Why?
Because he can't play like I like to hear drums. He's a terrible drummer. To me --
And -- Huh?
He's a terrible drummer for me. I couldn't play with him. We'd probably be like Jimmy Dorsey and Tommy Dorsey, fighting all the time.
You had another brother?
I had another -- Sidney, yes. Well, he was killed. He was shot. He and some other guy were fighting over his wife. That's a long time ago.
Did he ever play music?
No. No, he was a hard worker, just all labor.
